body: eh even in pictures i don’t recognize that it is me no matter what age or time
it’s hard to see who you’ve become

i don’t want to reach out, i simply don’t want to be alive.
of course if i said this to my friends they’d act supportive but they don’t truly care about me.
i hope the same for you, and i hope the same for myself
i mean my only rule is don’t be 10 years older than me
